title: Coordinate formula for the square-root scaling map
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$ that assigns nonzero mass to every point, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. For every $x\in\Omega$, the $x$-coordinate of the square-root scaling of $f$ is $\sqrt{\pi(x)}\,f(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
